title: Animation editor doesn't sort root nodes alphabetically
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.8.dev [51105ccbe58381774ecd7a7486d564b202a5192e]

(Most likely broken since alphabetical sorting was introduced.)

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (51105ccbe) - Fedora Linux 44 (Forty Four) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Single-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (RADV GFX1201) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 60.39 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

If you have an `AnimationPlayer` node that animates some property of its `root_node`, then that animation track will end up at (or near) the top of the track list, regardless of what the actual node name is.

This is simply because the actual `NodePath` of that track (which is what the sorting uses) ends up being something like `.:position`, and the `.` sorts before any alphanumeric character.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the MRP
2. Click the `AnimationPlayer` node
3. Enable the plain list view (i.e. disable any node grouping)
4. Enable the alphabetical sorting
5. Note how `B:position` sorts before `A:position`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[animation-sorting-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30750527/animation-sorting-bug.zip)
